review_candidates.title: GIS Specialist
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Purpose The GIS Specialist is responsible for preparing, managing, analyzing, and maintaining geospatial data to support the Egypt 360 street-level mapping project. The role involves processing geographic information, preparing and updating digital maps, planning and monitoring road coverage, validating spatial data, and coordinating with field and technical teams to ensure accurate and complete GIS deliverables in accordance with project requirements. Key Responsibilities A. GIS Data Manage
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role involves processing geographic information, preparing and updating digital maps, planning and monitoring road coverage, validating spatial data, and coordinating with field and technical teams to ensure accurate and complete GIS deliverables in accordance with project requirements. Coordination and Support • Coordinate with field operations, technical, and processing teams to ensure GIS requirements are met. Required Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Geomatics, Geography, Surveying, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline. General Responsibilities • Follow company policies, procedures, and project requirements.
